# Samarth Bhatia

> Computer Engineering undergrad at NTU Singapore with a second major in Business. Builds production-minded side projects — portfolio analytics, AWS tooling, browser extensions — and currently works as Product Lead at Money Pasar.

## Current

- Product Lead at [Money Pasar](https://moneypasar.com/) — cross-border transfers and collections for Southeast Asian SMEs.

## Selected projects

- [Vantage](https://vantage.samarthbhatia.dev/) — multi-asset, multi-currency portfolio tracker that separates FX movement from real asset returns.
- [Cloud Janitor](https://pypi.org/project/cloud-janitor/) — an 11-agent AWS remediation system that turns unstructured findings into reviewable Terraform.
